title: Authorization cancellation reversal timeline event added
description: Authorization cancellation reversal event added to user's timeline. For more information, see [Timeline events overview](https://developers.pismo.io/pismo-docs/docs/timeline-overview).

account_id.title: Account ID
account_id.description: User's account ID on Pismo platform

cardholder_currency_rate.title: Cardholder currency rate
cardholder_currency_rate.description: Factor used in conversion from transaction amount to cardholder billing amount

cardholderbilling_amount.title: Cardholder billing amount
cardholderbilling_amount.description: Transaction amount in the issuer’s currency

contract_amount.title: Contract amount
contract_amount.description: Total amount of the transaction, including all taxes and fees, in the cardholder's currency

currency_code.title: Currency code
currency_code.description: Numeric currency code for the country where the transaction took place. ISO_4217 numeric code.

currency_literal.title: Currency literal
currency_literal.description: Alphabetic currency code for the country where the transaction took place. ISO3166-1 literal 3-digit code.

entry_mode.title: POS entry mode
entry_mode.description: Code for point-of-sale entry mode used in the transaction. Varies by network.

entry_mode_literal.title: POS entry mode literal
entry_mode_literal.description: Point-of-sale entry mode used in the transaction. This is the name associated with the entry mode numeric code.

interest_rate.title: Interest rate
interest_rate.description: Interest rate that the issuer assesses the cardholder for the installment payment

is_referral.title: Is referral
is_referral.description: Indicates whether the transaction is suspected of fraud (true) or not (false).

local_amount.title: Amount in local currency
local_amount.description: Amount of funds the cardholder requested in the local currency of the acquirer or source location of the transaction

merchant_category_code.title: Merchant category code
merchant_category_code.description: Identifies the merchant that accepted the card used in the transaction.

merchant_category_group.title: Merchant category group
merchant_category_group.description: Merchant group based on category code

merchant_city.title: Merchant city
merchant_city.description: City in which the merchant is located

merchant_state_or_country.title: State or country of merchant
merchant_state_or_country.description: State or country where the merchant is located

tid.title: Transaction identifier received with the authorization message
tid.description: This identifier is generated by the card network. It is null in cases where the network doesn't send this value.

network.title: Network brand name
network.description: Brand name of the card network

org_operation.title: Organization operation
org_operation.description: An object representing the operation performed in response to the transaction. Contains only one property: `processing_code`.

processing_code.title: Processing code
processing_code.description: Describes the effect of a transaction on the customer account and the type of accounts affected.

pre_authorization.title: Pre-authorization
pre_authorization.description: Defines whether request is a pre-authorization (true) or not (false).

principal_amount.title: Principal amount
principal_amount.description: Amount of transaction without taxes and fees

response_code.title: Response code
response_code.description: Defines the disposition of a previous message or an action taken as a result of the receipt of a previous message.

settlement_currency_amount.title: Settlement currency amount
settlement_currency_amount.description: Amount of funds to be transferred from the issuer to the acquirer. This is the transaction amount in the settlement currency.

settlement_currency_code.title: Settlement currency code
settlement_currency_code.description: Numeric currency code for the country where the issuer is located. ISO_4217 numeric code.

settlement_currency_literal.description: Alphabetic currency code for the country where the issuer is located. ISO3166-1 literal 3-digit code.

settlement_currency_rate.title: Settlement currency rate
settlement_currency_rate.description: Factor used in the conversion from transaction to settlement amount

soft_descriptor.title: Soft descriptor
soft_descriptor.description: Merchant description including name, city and country code

to_name.title: To name
to_name.description: Name of the merchant that made the sale.

nsu.title: Network settlement utility (NSU)
nsu.description: System that tracks the flow of funds between parties involved in a payment card transaction, including the bank, the merchant, and the card network. Different payment card networks may have their own NSU systems, ie, Visa - VisaNet, Mastercard - BankNet, or they may use a third party.

retrieval_reference_number.title: Retrieval reference number
retrieval_reference_number.description: Document reference number assigned by the acquirer

authorization_code.title: Authorization code
authorization_code.description: Code assigned by authorizing institution to represent the authorization

ledger_update_id.title: ID of update performed on Ledger API
ledger_update_id.description: ID returned by the Ledger API. Identifies the account limit impact. This field might be null since some transactions generate timeline events but don't have any financial impact.

card_acceptor_id.title: Card acceptor ID
card_acceptor_id.description: Identifies the card acceptor that defines the point of the transaction in both local and interchange environments

cash_back_amount.title: Amount of cash back of the authorization
cash_back_amount.description: In purchase with cash back or POS withdrawal, this is the amount related to the withdrawal/cash back. The principal amount is the sum of this amount with the purchase amount.

token_information.title: Token information
token_information.description: Information about the token for a tokenized authorization

requestor_id.title: Requestor ID
requestor_id.description: A string that identifies the wallet that requested the token

type.title: Token type
type.description: A string that identifies the type of the token

network_token.title: Network token
network_token.description: Token provided by the network. For Visa requests, this field represents the value received in the F123, Usage 2, Dataset ID 68 (Token Data), Tag 01. For Mastercard requests, it is DE48, SE 33 PanMappingFileInformation, SF2 Account Number.

network_requestor_id.title: Network requestor ID
network_requestor_id.description: A string provided by the network that identifies the wallet that requested the token. For Visa requests, this field represents the value received in the F123, Usage 2, Dataset ID 68 (Token Data), Tag 03. For Mastercard requests, it is DE48, SE 33 PanMappingFileInformation, SF6 Token Requestor ID.

mti.title: Message type identifier
mti.description: Code representing the type of message.

cancelled_by_elapsed_time.title: Canceled by elapsed time
cancelled_by_elapsed_time.description: Indicates whether the authorization was canceled because too much time elapsed without a confirmation message. If so, its value is `true`. If the authorization was canceled by the acquirer, its value is `false`. For events other than cancellation timelines, its value is `null`.

metadata.title: Metadata from anti-fraud
metadata.description: Contains any valid JSON code sent in response to the anti-fraud request. This information is saved and included in the event in the form in which it was received, without any processing.

validation_results.title: Validation results
validation_results.description: Contains details of the results for all executed validations.

name.title: Validation name
name.description: The name that identifies the validation

status.title: Validation status
status.description: Represents the result of the validation.

reason.title: Validation reason
reason.description: Identifies the reason for the validation result.

description.title: Description
description.description: More detailed information about the validation result

additional_data.title: Additional data
additional_data.description: Contains additional information that is relevant for identifying how the validation was performed. Every validation will have its own additional data, so please refer to Pismo Developers Guide to identify every possibility.

dcc.title: DCC authorization
dcc.description: Indicates if an authorization is for dynamic currency conversion (DCC). DCC is a credit card feature that enables you to make a point-of-sale (POS) purchase in a foreign country using the currency of your home country. `dcc` should be true when the local amount is in the cardholder currency but the merchant is international.

incoming_response_code.title: Incoming response code from card network
incoming_response_code.description: Value received in field 39 of the card network specification. This is the response code the network assigned to the authorization. For cancellation messages, if this value is present, it might indicate the reason for the cancellation.

incoming_authorization_code.title: Incoming authorization code from card network
incoming_authorization_code.description: Value received in field 38 of the card network specification. This is the authorization code the network assigned to the authorization.

program_id.title: Program ID
program_id.description: Program ID of the card used in the authorization
